verdict.rationale: Zep generates and incrementally updates natural-language thread summaries from ingested messages. That is an AI-generated digest of the user's data produced by the product itself. Its auto-scoped Context Block composes relevant context automatically, but this is retrieval rather than insight generation. There is no evidence of suggestions, recommendations or in-dashboard insight surfaces. missing for 10: AI-generated suggestions/recommendations, insights surfaced inside the product UI/dashboard, analysis beyond per-thread summaries, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: A thread summary is a natural-language summary of the messages in a single thread, generated and incrementally updated by Zep.
let Zep dynamically compose the most relevant context across edges, nodes, episodes, observations, and thread summaries into a single ready-to-use block
